# Installation

Keecas is available on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/keecas/), install with the package manager of your choice.

## Using pip (classic)

The simplest way to install Keecas:

```bash
pip install keecas
```

## Using uv (Modern Python Package Manager)

If you're using the modern [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) package manager:

```bash
uv add keecas
```

## Install as executable

keecas also has a limited cli interface, so if you want to be available system wide I recommend using `pipx` or `uv tool`:

```bash
pipx install keecas
```

```bash
uv tool install keecas
```

## Development Installation

For development or to access the latest features:

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/kompre/keecas.git
cd keecas

# Install in development mode with uv
uv sync

# Or with pip
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Verification

Verify the installation:

```bash
keecas --version
```

## External Tools

For generating scientific documents from your calculations:

- **[Quarto](https://quarto.org/)**: Render notebooks to PDF, HTML, and other formats

## Troubleshooting

### Import Errors

If you get import errors:

```bash
# Ensure you're using the correct Python environment
which python
pip list | grep keecas

# Reinstall if needed
pip uninstall keecas
pip install keecas
```

### Missing Dependencies

If calculations don't display properly in notebooks:

```bash
# Ensure IPython is installed
pip install ipython jupyter
```

### CLI Not Available

If the `keecas` command isn't found:

```bash
# Check if it's in your PATH
which keecas

# If not, ensure site-packages/bin is in PATH
# Or use: python -m keecas
```
